label: 1. It's not often for something so interesting to…

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: It's not often for something so interesting to occur.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I received your message from that backwater you're all living in.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: What do you wish me to do?
I hope you can assist us in battle.
I hope you can help us reclaim the surface.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I can see why you would want that,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but it's of no interest to me.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: I'll give you one more chance.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Try and put a smile on my face this time around.
And how do I do that?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You're asking me?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: A foolish question, if there ever was one.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Nevertheless, you have piqued my interest, so I will forgive you.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: If you wish to please me, it is quite simple.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You, as the prey, must do your utmost to

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: compliment me, the predator.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Speak your honeyed words and praise me to the heavens,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but do not ask me what specific words you must utter.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: That responsibility rests on your shoulders.
So basically, I need to be a skilled orator who can paint a picture with words.
So basically, I need to get on your good side.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Putting a little bit of veneration in there

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: certainly wouldn't hurt, either.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Now, I will ask you for the last time.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: What do you wish me to do?
Oh noble predator of the surface, would you kindly lend me your protection?

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Finally.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: A decent speech.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: And what do you offer me in return?
My reverence.
My service.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Still a bit rough around the edges,

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: but you know your place in the presence of the strong, and that pleases me.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Very well.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Your wish will be fulfilled.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: You may summon me whenever

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: you need me or are in jeopardy.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Regardless of the distance, I will find you.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: But keep in mind, you should be grateful and

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: never forget the promise you have made to me.

lines.speaker: harran
lines.text: Otherwise, the one who was once your protector will become your greatest enemy.
I'll keep that in mind.
